sloka: प्रयान्तं तु महाघोरं राक्षसं भीमविक्रमम् ।अन्तरिक्षगता घोराः शकुनाः प्रत्यवारयन् ।। ६.५१.३० ।।।।
transliteration: prayāntaṁ tu mahāghoraṁ rākṣasaṁ bhīmavikramam ।antarikṣagatā ghorāḥ śakunāḥ pratyavārayan ।। 6.51.30 ।।।।

translations.english: Heroic Rakshasa, Dhumraksha surrounded by rakshasas set forth laughing to the west gate where Hanuman stood.
